name: awe-tracegate
description: Offline, keyless discovery and evidence skills for improving agent work without trusting model output as proof.

interface.shortDescription: Verify agent changes with replayable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills for checking readiness, turning one agent goal into a measurable discovery cycle, verifying exact evidence, integrating evaluation exports, and preparing redacted evidence for human review. The skills only orchestrate the offline TraceGate CLI; model or skill output is never verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this repository is ready for TraceGate.
Turn this agent improvement goal into one measurable candidate.
Verify these evidence artifacts without executing them.
